overview: This paper proposes SAM-Veteran, an MLLM-based agent that interacts with the Segment Anything Model (SAM) in a human-like reasoning-driven workflow for reasoning segmentation, utilizing a multi-task reinforcement learning framework (GRPO) with dynamic sampling to enable bounding box generation, iterative mask refinement, and adaptive termination.

modules.name: Data Processing and Mask Augmentation
modules.description: Handles the construction of training datasets for the three tasks. This includes loading RefCOCOg data, generating visual inputs by overlaying green transparent masks on images, categorizing SAM-generated masks into 'Need Refinement' or 'Good Enough' classes based on IoU thresholds, and implementing the auxiliary task augmentation by introducing random polygonal inclusions (false positives) and exclusions (false negatives) into ground-truth masks.

modules.name: Multi-Task Prompting and Response Parsing
modules.description: Manages the specific textual prompts for Textual Grounding, Mask Comprehension, and Auxiliary tasks. Implements the logic to enforce output formatting (thinking process and final answer tags) and parses the MLLM's generated responses to extract structured data such as bounding box coordinates, positive/negative point coordinates, and null terminations.

modules.name: SAM Environment Wrapper (MDP Formulation)
modules.description: Implements the Markov Decision Process environment interface interacting with SAM. Defines the state representation (Image, Question, Mask), handles action execution (passing bounding boxes for initial segmentation or points for iterative refinement to SAM), computes the transition to the next state (updated mask), and manages the iterative refinement loop.

modules.name: Reward Engine
modules.description: Calculates the multi-component reward signals for the reinforcement learning framework. Implements Box Reward (IoU and L1), SAM Reward (Mask IoU), Formatting Reward, Decision Reward (mask quality judgment), IoU Improvement Reward (delta IoU), and the specific Point/Decision rewards for the Auxiliary task. Includes the logic for computing IoU excluding near-edge pixels for training stability.

modules.name: Dynamic Sampling Strategy
modules.description: Implements the DAPO-inspired dynamic sampling technique to stabilize GRPO training. For the grounding task, this involves over-sampling candidate boxes and applying Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) to ensure reward diversity. For mask and auxiliary tasks, it over-samples actions until all four point-case scenarios (null-null, pos-null, null-neg, pos-neg) are represented in the batch.

modules.name: GRPO Optimization Engine
modules.description: Implements the Group Relative Policy Optimization algorithm. Handles the computation of group advantages, policy gradient clipping, KL divergence penalties, and the application of global batch normalization to stabilize variance during the multi-task reinforcement learning updates.

modules.name: MLLM Actor Module
modules.description: Wraps the Multimodal Large Language Model (Qwen2.5-VL) as the policy agent. Manages the model's forward pass for generating multiple rollouts (reasoning chains and action outputs), handling visual encoding of images and overlaid masks, and providing the log probabilities required for the GRPO optimization step.

modules.name: SAM Segmentation Module
modules.description: Wraps the Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) used as the execution backbone. Provides interfaces for initial mask prediction from bounding box prompts and iterative mask refinement from point prompts combined with previous mask logits, acting as the deterministic transition function in the MDP.

modules.name: Multi-Task RL Training Orchestrator
modules.description: Manages the end-to-end training loop across the three tasks. Coordinates data loading, rollout generation via the MLLM Actor, environment interaction via the SAM Wrapper, reward calculation, dynamic sampling, and the GRPO weight update step. Handles the balancing of task frequencies and early stopping of dynamic sampling.

modules.name: Evaluation Metrics Calculator
modules.description: Implements the evaluation logic for reasoning segmentation. Calculates standard metrics like generic IoU (gIoU) and cumulative IoU (cIoU) against ground truth masks, as well as the Termination Ratio metric to assess the adaptive stopping behavior of the agent.

modules.name: Agentic Inference Pipeline
modules.description: Implements the human-like inference workflow for SAM-Veteran. Executes the sequential process: generating an initial bounding box from the query, producing the initial mask via SAM, iteratively prompting the MLLM for refinement points based on the current mask, and terminating when the model outputs null points or reaches the maximum refinement step limit.

modules.name: Experiment and Ablation Framework
modules.description: Provides configurations and execution scripts for comprehensive validation. Includes settings for ablation studies (removing tasks, specific rewards, dynamic sampling, or Chain-of-Thought), benchmark testing on in-domain (RefCOCO series) and out-of-domain (ReasonSeg, MMR, MUSE) datasets, general MLLM capability tests, and computational efficiency analysis (measuring inference steps and time).
